name: Netgear Meural
description: Sign in to Netgear to display one image at a time. This unofficial cloud API can stop working. Use the Meural app to manage galleries, playback and native sleep schedules. An optional LAN address enables Tesserae quiet-hours control.

delivery_method.label: Delivery method
delivery_method.help: Cloud delivers the latest changed page after the minimum interval. Local previews use the frame address.

host.label: Frame address
host.help: Optional for cloud delivery; used for quiet-hours control. Required for local previews. Filled from your account when available. Reserve its address in your router.

refresh_interval_s.label: Local preview renewal
refresh_interval_s.help: Seconds between local uploads of the current page (5 to 3600). Keep it shorter than the frame's preview duration, which is often 30 seconds, or the frame drops back to its own artwork. 0 sends each page once. New pages are sent immediately.

cloud_interval_s.label: Minimum cloud delivery interval
cloud_interval_s.help: Seconds between cloud deliveries. Renders in between are combined; the latest page wins.
